title: Host attestation (PLANNED, v1)
description: DESIGN ONLY. MacGuard Cloud does not exist. What a host says about itself at a point in time: agent and tool versions, the intelligence release it holds (identified by the existing rules_root / manifest hash), and the result of local self-checks. It is a CLAIM signed by the agent key; the Cloud records it, it does not turn it into proof of host integrity. Hardware-rooted attestation is out of scope for v1.

nonce.description: Service-issued, single use; prevents replay of an old attestation.

tools.description: e.g. mgctl, macguard-audit, yara engine; versions as reported.

locally_verified.description: True only if the local verifier reported success for this release.

result.description: A skip is never reported as a pass.
